host-change: editing one host's configuration, profile or service module, where a single host must pass its module-system check
chain-change: editing a shared module that several hosts import through a feature chain, where the blast radius must be found before the edit
flake-change: editing flake wiring, outputs, the host inventory or the module registry, where the projection assembles every configuration
gate-change: adding or changing a check, lint or assertion, where the new gate must fail on a real past mistake before it may pass
task-change: adding or changing a task, its summary, or its place in a taskfile shard
prose-change: editing documentation, a skill page or a code comment, where the prose budget and the comment census apply
note-change: writing or promoting an AGENTS.nix note: a decision, an experiment, an open todo or a handoff
bug-fix: a symptom whose cause is unknown, where the space must be bisected and one proven fix applied
perf: a request to make something faster or smaller, where a measurement has to come before the claim
incident: a live host misbehaving now, where health, unit state and the sentinel ledger are read before any config edit
secret: anything touching sops, age keys, hashed passwords or a secret value
deploy: moving a built configuration onto a host, with plan, apply, validate and a rollback path
research: a question about a fact, a host or a design, answered rather than changed
decision: choosing which model, provider or lane should answer a decision, scored on calibrated probability
novel: a request that matches no other label, which must be checked against the design record first
publish: publishing a site, blog post or static surface from the repo rather than editing it on a host
